proposals.title: win-differential-last-5-games: top-2 SOTA feature (MDPI Computation 2025)
proposals.key_insight: win-differential-last-5-games AND season-win-differential are the top 2 features achieving Brier~0.20 on NBA in 2025. These should be near top of our 7246 feature set. Verify presence in features/engine.py before adding.
proposals.actionable: Check features/engine.py for: recent_wins_last_5, win_diff_last_5, season_win_diff. If missing, add to 'momentum_recent_5game' category. AFTER engine-parity-sync (priority=40). This is the single highest-impact feature gap identified this cycle.

proposals.title: LR Brier=0.199 confirmed 10th time as NBA pre-game SOTA
proposals.key_insight: No deep learning model beats LR on NBA PRE-GAME prediction in 2025-2026 literature. LR=0.199 is effectively the SOTA ceiling for pre-game only features. Our xgboost_brier at 0.221 CAN close the gap with better calibration.
proposals.actionable: vm-add-logistic-regression already queued (priority=50). Confirmed in S13 (NBA) and P7 (POL). Scale to remaining islands.

proposals.title: Isotonic regression post-hoc calibration closes tree vs LR gap
proposals.key_insight: Tree ensembles have higher discrimination but systematic miscalibration. Isotonic/Platt correction closes gap to LR baseline. Our xgboost (0.221) lags LR (0.199) partly due to calibration — not feature gap alone.
proposals.actionable: Isotonic calibration already applied in Colab (0.22054 result). Verify GA island evaluation also uses isotonic calibration in fitness scoring — not just in final model export.

proposals.title: Brier-score objective training is the key lever (arXiv:2508.02725)
proposals.key_insight: Training with Brier loss directly (not log-loss/BCE) is the single biggest lever. Our xgboost_brier already uses this. Verify LightGBM variants also use brier objective (not default binary cross-entropy).
proposals.actionable: xgboost_brier model type already uses Brier objective. Verify lightgbm_brier model type in island codebase uses matching objective. NCAA Brier=0.1589 is NOT comparable to NBA (seed information + bracket structure).

proposals.title: Optimal feature count 30-80 per PLOS One systematic review (34 studies)
proposals.source: PLOS One Jun 2025 systematic review of 34 NBA prediction studies
proposals.key_insight: Systematic review of 34 studies: optimal pre-game NBA feature count is 20-50 selected features. More features → overfitting. Our pareto selects 37-75 features — ALREADY IN the optimal range.
proposals.actionable: Current pareto selection 37-75 features is optimal. Maintain MAX_FEATURES=200 cap but note GA naturally converges to 40-80 range. Do not increase the cap.

proposals.title: MC-Dropout uncertainty quantification for prediction intervals (MDPI Information 2026)
proposals.key_insight: MC-dropout on LSTM provides calibrated uncertainty estimates. Shot-chart spatial embeddings novel feature. Requires play-by-play spatial data not in current pipeline.
proposals.actionable: LOW PRIORITY. Shot-chart embeddings need play-by-play spatial data — unavailable in current data pipeline. Revisit when HERMES browser scraper can fetch ESPN play-by-play.

proposals.title: NB+AdaBoost+MLP+KNN+XGB+DT+LR stacked ensemble — Nat Sci Reports Aug 2025
proposals.key_insight: Accuracy 0.87 with stacked diverse classifiers. AdaBoost+NaiveBayes not yet in our model pool.
proposals.actionable: vm-add-adaboost-naive-bayes-model-pool queued (priority=56). Stacking is BANNED in islands (Rule#8) but AdaBoost+NB can be added as standalone model types.

proposals.title: TabICL tabular foundation model (ICML 2025) — already in production
proposals.key_insight: TabICL is our best production result (0.21139 walk-forward holdout Colab, window-biased; honest 0.22054). Production-ready on GPU only.
proposals.actionable: Already deployed. Focus CPU tree ensemble improvements to approach TabICL quality without GPU cost.
